name: post-graphics-preparation-draw-observer

callee.prototype: void* WINAPI NativePrepareGraphics(void* context, BYTE indexed, void* opaque)

parameters.DL: Indexed flag byte. DirectDraw/DrawInstanced0, indexed variants1, indirect obtains caller flag; upper RDX bits are not semantic input.
parameters.R8: Opaque preparation/ownership pointer preserved from caller stack; do not dereference or reinterpret.

callee.return: Exact native command-context/list pointer inRAX, nullable; notBOOL and notHRESULT.

callsites.replacement: 5-byte relativeCALL to ordinary compiled typed wrapper; original caller branch and stack unchanged.

shim_contract.delegate: Call the guarded original callee EXACTLY ONCE with unchanged three typed arguments.
shim_contract.observe: Only after original returns nonNULL, collect bounded read-only state from the same native context, then return the exact original pointer.
shim_contract.failure: If original returnsNULL, preserveNULL and skip observer. Do not issue a draw or bypass caller failure branch.
shim_contract.state: Native12a6d0 has already selected pipeline, prepared resources and refreshed CBV/SRV descriptors before returning; the callers have not yet called edf00 to record draw.
shim_contract.thread: Called from native draw backend; no public immediate-frontend lock/flush/wait or state-changingAPI. Worker-thread ownership itself must be verified from native context/device/thread metadata before assuming arbitrary context is stable.
shim_contract.side_effects: No GPUwait,Flush,ClearState,state restoration/reset or timing/deadline changes.
shim_contract.abi: Normal compiled Win64 wrapper must preserve all nonvolatile registers, stack alignment/shadow space and unwind metadata; preserve native return pointer. Internal observer errors cannot replace a successful native return. Preserve original GetLastError across observation.
shim_contract.integration: Root owns guarded host builder hook/import/stub. No shared build script was changed by this recipe.

validation_scope: File-only SHA/PE/x64CALL decoding and mutation rejection. No executable/DLL loaded and no game/GUI/GPU device created.
